title: Teaching SPA interaction inventory
description: The inventory of named, individually addressable interactions (spec 005 section 2.4). The pattern enum is exactly the nine patterns of that table. Visual patterns must declare longDescriptionId (AC19); patterns whose table row requires a status live region must declare statusRegion true. Whether ids are unique and segment and dataset resolve is checked by scripts/spa/validate.mjs, which JSON Schema cannot express.

$schema.description: Relative path to the schema this file is validated against. Constrained so it cannot hold a sentence.

id.description: Id of the component in the built DOM (AC6). Unique within the inventory.

pattern.description: Interaction pattern; the nine patterns of spec 005 section 2.4.

segment.description: Id of the deck.json segment this interaction belongs to.

keys.description: Keys that operate the component, as Playwright key names (Space for the spacebar, Shift+Tab for a chord).

statusRegion.description: Whether the component writes to a status live region.

longDescriptionId.description: DOM id of the long description of a visual component (AC19).

dataset.description: Id of the datasets/*.json dataset behind a chart or simulation.
